routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (10/27 표현 + 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

items.prompt: 예상되는 — the date you will finish 대신
~되는 대로 바로 알려 주세요 (패턴, 뒤에 주어+동사)
items.answer: Please update us as soon as ~.
Just a reminder that ~ is due ~.

cover_practice.prompt: 명확히 하다: Could you c______ who checks the roll tags?
반드시 ~하게 하다: Please e_____ that every roll has a tag.
과거의: We do not need h_________ data from before October.
필수의: Safety shoes are m________ in the cutting room.
중복된: Please delete the d________ entry in the system.

words.meaning: 명확히 하다, 분명히 설명하다 — explain again 대신
words.example: Please clarify who enters the lot number, EXIM or the warehouse.
Please ensure all quality issues are fixed before the final inspection.
Please do not upload historical receipts from before October.
The lot number is mandatory for every fabric upload.
Keeping the lot on paper and in the system is duplicate work.

patterns.pattern: I didn't mean ~. What I need is ~.
patterns.meaning: ~하라는 뜻은 아니었습니다. 제가 필요한 건 ~입니다 (오해를 바로잡을 때, I wanted you to ~ 대신)
patterns.skeleton: I didn't mean + to [동사] / What I need is + (for you) to [동사] 또는 [명사]
patterns.email: I didn't mean that you should upload old receipts. What I need is a check of the attached file.
patterns.spoken: Sorry, not that. I just need you to check it.

patterns.pattern: Below are the options for ~. Please let me know which one works for you by ~.
patterns.meaning: ~ 선택지는 아래와 같습니다. ~까지 어느 것이 좋은지 알려 주세요 (Please choose one 대신, 부드럽게)
patterns.skeleton: which one + works for you + by [날짜]
patterns.email: Below are three flight options for Nov 15. Please let me know which one works for you by Oct 28.

patterns.meaning: 혹시 ~가 ~할 방법이 있을까요? (Can you ~? 대신, 막혔을 때 정중하게)
patterns.email: Is there any way the warehouse can enter the lot when the fabric goes on the rack?
patterns.spoken: Any way you can do it today?

rewrite.original: The lot number must be entered in the system. Our goal is to remove paper, so keeping the lot only on paper means double work.
rewrite.improved: The lot number must be entered in the system. We are going paperless, so keeping the lot only on paper creates duplicate work.
rewrite.note: remove paper → go paperless: 업무에서 굳어진 표현이라 목표가 한 번에 읽힌다. Our goal is to ~ 대신 We are going ~으로 진행 중인 일로 보여 지시가 더 단단해진다. means double work → creates duplicate work: '일을 만든다'는 동사가 문제를 분명히 하고, duplicate는 시스템·서류 중복을 말할 때 쓰는 표준 단어다.

source: 10/27 보낸 메일(QR 시스템 lot 번호 입력·Mint·Hien, 원단 실사 전 점검·Trinh, 봉제실장 항공편 선택지·Asanka, 소모품 리스트·Van), 받은 메일(Trinh 'clarify whether ~ historical data', Trinh 'Is there any way you can ~', J.Crew Ariana 'ensure that all quality issues are addressed')
